claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. Let L(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee.leading. Let R(n) be the sum of the monomials in guarantee.remainder.terms, each coefficient times n^exponent*(log2 n)^log_exponent*(log2 log2 n)^loglog_exponent; an empty sum is zero. There exists N such that C_B2(f_n)>=L(n)-R(n) for every integer n>=N. All remainder coefficients are the exact declared constants. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total fixed-strength certificate-prefix language defined in proof.md and family.py, with STRENGTH=1024 and delta=1/1024 fixed independently of input length. At actual length N its guarded uniform algorithm reads a validated list of odd-degree field polynomials from an input prefix, charges all prefix bits to N, zero-pads the payload to N coordinates, and runs the balanced-tree challenge-response construction with the explicit strength-scaled fixed integer parameters. Every failed shape or prefix test returns zero. All remaining choices are deterministic. The polynomial runtime has an enormous fixed exponent; practical input lengths take the documented constant-zero guard.","guarantee":{"kind":"eventual_lower_bound","leading":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"remainder":{"kind":"explicit","terms":[{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"9"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1024","numerator":"1"},"log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}}]}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this one fixed total language in P, hence NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-9N^(1/1024) for every sufficiently large integer actual length N in the full pinned B2 model. Its complete guarantee implies liminf C_B2(F_N)/N>=4. Every extractor, field, gate and parameter argument is supplied; STRENGTH is fixed and does not grow with N, and no subpolynomial-remainder endpoint is asserted.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v2"}

experiments.purpose: Bounded exact B2 identities and ternary potential arithmetic, integer-root inequalities, general irreducibility versus exhaustive division, explicit tower field laws, design intersections, code linearity and actual small-length constant-zero guard evaluations. These finite predicates do not prove the universal theorem or execute its enormous nontrivial asymptotic instances.
